title: Refine input-group token heuristics and validation z-indexing for composed fields
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Problem: Several composed input patterns (phone + country select, credit card block, address line groups) exhibit inconsistent vertical rhythm and validation layering across compact and regular densities. Error messages sometimes overlap adjacent controls or are clipped under floating helper rows; popover-based suggestions (autocomplete, format hints) get occluded by validation banners due to z-index ordering. Goals: 1) Define token heuristics for inter-field spacing in composed groups that scale by density token and font-size token. 2) Create a clear stacking/z-index policy for helper text, error messages, autofill suggestions, and floating labels so errors are always visible and don’t block inputs or tooltips. 3) Deliver component-level props and guidelines so devs can opt into "stacked" vs "inline" validation for multi-part inputs. Acceptance criteria: - Token recipes documented in Confluence + token JSON example for spacing per density (compact/regular/comfortable). - Figma components updated for composed inputs with states (default, focused, filled, error, soft-warning). - CSS z-index variables and recommended ordering merged in component library; no regression in existing forms (QA checklist). - Accessibility: screen reader flow for grouped errors is linear and announces the group label and error content. Links to artifacts: Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/REDWOOD/Forms-Input-Groups, Confluence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Composed+Input+Spacing+and+Validation, initial PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/2147 (draft). Trade-offs: Increasing vertical spacing in compact density may marginally impact perceived information density; we will offer a token override for strict compact use cases. We also consider supporting a prefix/suffix dedicated region to minimize z-index complexity for small adornments.
comments: 2026-02-10 Sofia Chen: Created ticket after UX audit uncovered 6 instances where error toasts overlap adjacent fields in compact layouts.

2026-02-11 Aisha Patel: Initial sketches posted in Figma. Explored two token strategies: fixed-step spacing vs. formula based on font-size * multiplier. Leaning toward formula to support variable type scales.

2026-02-12 Mateo Gomez (ENG): Raised dependency ENG-4218 for a runtime class on composed-field wrappers; engineering needs to expose an API to surface group-level aria attributes. Marked as dependency.
2026-02-13 Sofia Chen: Added acceptance criteria and QA checklist to Confluence. Linked accessibility testing tasks and WCAG expectations.

2026-02-14 Aisha Patel: Reviewed with Design leadership. Decided z-index token names: --z-input, --z-helper, --z-error, --z-popover. Will keep values small integers to avoid conflicts with global layers.

2026-02-15 Mateo Gomez (ENG): Draft PR created (https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/2147). Implemented token recipe and a composed-field wrapper component. Needs design review for spacing choices.

2026-02-16 Accessibility review (contractor): Confirmed screen reader flow when using role=group + aria-describedby works but requires explicit focus management for multi-part inputs; added note to engineering tasks.

2026-02-18 Aisha Patel: Design review comments posted — tightened error copy spacing and suggested a small animation to reveal the error region to reduce layout shift. Assigned follow-up to ENG-4218 and DES-33890 for animation spec.
